name: vignelli-canon-design-system
description: Massimo Vignelli's design discipline distilled from The Vignelli Canon — the Intangibles (semantics, discipline, appropriateness, timelessness, equity) and the Tangibles (grid, six typefaces, two-size scale, rulers, primary-color-as-identifier, white space) as an applyable method, plus railway-signage module logic, a deterministic token generator, and production notes. For disciplined, timeless, Swiss-modernist artifacts: identity systems, style guides, editorial/poster layouts, transit signage and route diagrams. Triggers: Vignelli, design/identity system, brand guidelines, wayfinding, subway map, route diagram, poster layout, timeless typography, 品牌规范, 导视系统.
